content.evidence_note: Actual worked proof recipe read in selected v2, with explicit source-linked Gaussian and geometric interfaces; not independent certification of the full lower-bound proof.
failure_modes: Censoring old fitted means breaks exact replay and may make supports singular.
Treating reference innovation seeds as true-oracle noise changes the model.
Conditioning on truncated tensors during Gaussian posterior/KL calculations is invalid.
Geometric coupling can depend on policy; there is no claimed single good event for all policies.
A recipe alone supplies neither an established transferable theorem nor a complete Hard Family.
content.goal_pattern: Transfer whole-query-span geometric hiding into a fixed-distribution exact value-gradient lower bound.
content.key_choice: Sample each true tensor once. In the reference retain the minimum-norm tensor M_{k,t-1} fitting the reference process's own old answers. With V_{k,t}=span{Sym(z_i^tensor(k-1) tensor v):i<=t,v in R^d}, B_{k,t}=L_{k,t}(I-P_{V_{k,t-1}}), C=B B*, return L M+B S_{k,vis}(t)+sigma_k C^(1/2)zeta_{k,t}. The reference innovation seeds are independent physical Gaussian vectors, not fresh true-oracle noise.
content.key_relation: Under the true law, conditional on U, omega and the complete adaptive history, the two tensor posteriors factorize as N(M+(I-P_V)S_k,sigma_k^2(I-P_V)). The new true and reference answers have identical affine support and covariance; their means differ by B S_{k,hid}(t). Thus KL(Q||P)=sum_{k=3,4}(1/(2 sigma_k^2))sum_t E_Q||P_{Delta V_{k,t}}S_{k,hid}(t)||_F^2, Delta V=V_t intersect V_{t-1}^perp. B=0 gives exact replay and zero contribution. If ||P_{W_s}b_s||<=theta for all s with probability >=1-zeta under Q, W_s=span{z_i:i<=min(T,tau_s-1)}, then KL<=(N^2/2)sum_k(k w_k^2/sigma_k^2)(theta^(2(k-1))+zeta); no extra T factor.
proof_skeleton: D.1 pp.24–27: condition on U and seed; predictable queries preserve channel factorization. Past linear observations fix the projection onto V and leave an orthogonal Gaussian residual. Every reference history is feasible: update M_t=M_{t-1}+B* (BB*)^dagger(Y_t-L M_{t-1}). Equal supports, including zero-dimensional point masses, inductively imply absolute continuity and justify the KL chain rule along reference histories.

D.2 pp.27–28: rank-one tensor projection satisfies ||P_{V_k(W)}b^tensor k||_F^2<=k||P_W b||^(2(k-1)). Orthogonal observation increments telescope before each disclosure; Cauchy–Schwarz over hidden readouts yields the N^2 bound without multiplying by T.

C.1–C.8 pp.18–24: repeat Q_0 K+1 times, keep active space A_0 in the first copy, and set Q_U=U(I tensor Q_0)U^T. Deterministic nested I_t subset A_0 obey Qbar I_t subset I_{t+1}; b_s is undisclosed until tau_s. With independent physical advice fixed, deferred Haar exposure yields latent query containment I_t+R_cyclic using iid canonical Gaussian starts conditional on advice, not independent of U. For L=T+1, d>D_0+2L and K+1>=128[(L+1)log17+log(4J/zeta)], the entire pre-disclosure query span has hidden-readout projection <=theta=2sqrt(32[(L+1)log17+log(4J/zeta)]/(K+1)).

C.8 and E.2.3: reference means, fitters and covariances depend only on physical history and disclosed readouts. Fixing independent physical reference seeds therefore gives an allowed Haar policy; conditioning on complete static tensors or the full physical quadratic matrix would not. A final unqueried output is frozen before the analyst-only terminal disclosure and receives no observation.

D.3 pp.28–30: the true fixed function is (F_U+P_Z)(rho_R(x))+eta_0||x||^2/2. Exact quartic cores give cubic/quartic tensors with w_3=-120 tau A^3 and w_4=120 tau A^4. Values are recovered by z^T Y_k/k; disclosed taper corrections complete the value-gradient simulator. Using the same U,Z_3,Z_4,omega couples complete true fixed-function and assembled-channel histories until first hidden core exit.

D.7 and E.2: a geometric event excludes hidden-core exits and forces the terminal readout inside the robust nonstationarity threshold. Pinsker transfers this event with loss sqrt(KL/2). Only afterwards condition on the static norm event G_Z. With P(G_Z)>=1-4 exp(-4d), average success is <=(zeta+sqrt(KL/2))/(1-4 exp(-4d)).
content.required_inputs: Finite d,N,T; H_k=Sym^k(R^d) with Frobenius inner product and averaged symmetrization, k=3,4. Hidden U and independent private seed omega, independent of independent isonormal Gaussian tensors Z_3,Z_4. Unit b_s=b_s(U), fixed weights w_k, sigma_k>0, S_k=w_k sum_s b_s^tensor k, Theta_k=S_k+sigma_k Z_k. Deterministic disclosure times tau_s in {1,...,T+1} union {infinity}. Predictable common query z_t gives Y_{k,t}=L_{k,t}Theta_k, L_{k,t}A=A[z_t^tensor(k-1),dot]. Reveal k=3 then 4, with no intervening action. Conditional on U, allowed side answers are deterministic functions of queries/history and reveal no unobserved tensor information. Standard-Borel measurable histories are required.
transfer_obligations: Realize the entire true adaptive transcript by one fixed random object; independently resampling true answers is invalid.
Prove posterior factorization for the actual full feedback, allowed side information and within-round ordering.
Reprove Haar-side-information compatibility, whole-span bound, and response-free output handling; a per-query correlation bound is insufficient.
Supply exact core agreement, global model membership, robust stationarity obstruction, final conditioning and the intended cap/success quantifiers.
